algorithm.backgroundProof: strict magenta gate plus four-neighbour connection to board exterior; only large dense enclosed strict-magenta components are additionally proven as backdrop holes
algorithm.poseRecovery: whole-board connected components recover complete poses that cross nominal 384x512 source cells; eight primaries are ordered 4+4 by row and centroid x

scale.rigidLandmark: posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction

idle.landmark: posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction
posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction

move.landmark: posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction
posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction

attack.landmark: posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction
posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction

death.landmark: posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction
posterior croup at tail-base contour to anterior shoulder/neck junction

scale.selection: idle baseline is fit-clamped; each other clip uses idle rigid-median / clip rigid-median and is independently fit-clamped; one uniform factor per complete clip, never per pose

algorithm.resampling: one reviewed uniform x/y factor per clip, premultiplied-alpha LANCZOS, no per-pose factor and no non-uniform stretch
algorithm.root: cell-centred body-mass landmark with stable lower-exclusive support line

despill.topology: foreground-only pixels within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background

residualMatteHueThreshold.purpose: remove only edge pixels retaining matte-like R/B parity; russet/brown with low blue is excluded

deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels in one nominal target cell
deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.basis: independent neutral-background audit of violet-magenta crest, belly, tail and leg contamination

despill.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the strict magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
despill.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
despill.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
foreground/background membership must remain byte-identical
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero
